name: Reef
description: Two marks to a cell — a bar and a disc — building up like coral against a ruled ground.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: @pick(10%, 54%); width: 76%; height: 18%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(14%, 52%); top: @pick(50%, 12%); @size: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.35) { -webkit-box-shadow: -1px -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: -1px -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
